title: 第23章 二郎要了我吧第24章 拜入武馆
slug: 打猎娶妻加点我无敌了
lines: 天空一片昏暗。
林夜牵着张雪柔走了一段距离，回头看向她。
张雪柔身体微微颤抖着，眼眶发红，眼里泛着水雾。
眼泪在眼眶打了个圈，又憋了回去。
她紧紧攥着剪刀，指节泛白，整个人如同受惊的兔子。
委屈，忐忑，害怕。
林夜双手握住张雪柔的手，一点点将她僵硬的手掰开。
拿起剪刀，她掌心还有道道指甲印。
林夜有些心疼，放缓声音：
“雪柔姐，已经没事了。”
张雪柔抬起头，咬着下唇盯着他。
“二郎！”
她突然抱住林夜，眼泪绝提，呜咽着哭出声来。
“我没有让他们得逞，我……我好怕……”
林夜抱着她，轻轻拍着她的背。
“我都看到了，雪柔姐很勇敢，别怕，我在呢。”
感受着怀里颤抖的娇躯，林夜又摸了摸她的长发，声音更加温柔。
“是我来晚了，让你受到惊吓。”
在他的安抚下，张雪柔终于停止了颤抖。
半晌后，她推开林夜，慌乱地擦着眼泪。
林夜摸了摸她的头：
“雪柔姐，这种事以后再也不会有，你信我么？”
张雪柔不敢抬头看他，只是轻轻点了点头，声音也小得和蚊子叫一样。
“我相信的。”
林夜露出笑容，牵起张雪柔的手。
“走吧，一起回家。”
张雪柔不再挣扎，任由他牵着，仿佛这样才能安心。
林夜走了几步，突然想起什么，看向张雪柔的同时打开面板。
【张雪柔】
魅力83（可达92）
好感度：80。
他不由一怔。
我擦，好感度这就80了？
英雄救美虽然俗套，但杀伤力依旧十分惊人。
对一个古代女子来说，这个好感意味着可以心甘情愿嫁给他。
一想到很快就能和张雪柔成婚。
林夜糟糕的心情，稍微好了点。
一路回到村子，天已经擦黑。
张雪柔尝试着缩回手，林夜却根本不让。
她小声呼唤：“二郎。”

The sky was dark.
Lin Ye led Zhang Xuerou for a short distance and looked back at her.
Zhang Xuerou's body was trembling slightly, her eyes were red and misty.
Tears circled in his eyes and he held them back.
She clutched the scissors tightly, her knuckles turned white, and she looked like a frightened rabbit.
Grievance, anxiety, fear.
Lin Ye held Zhang Xuerou's hand with both hands and opened her stiff hand bit by bit.
Picking up the scissors, there were still nail marks on her palms.
Lin Ye felt a little distressed and lowered his voice:
"Sister Xuerou, it's okay."
Zhang Xuerou raised her head, biting her lower lip and staring at him.
"Erlang!"
She suddenly hugged Lin Ye, burst into tears, and sobbed.
"I didn't let them succeed, I...I was so scared..."
Lin Ye hugged her and patted her back gently.
"I've seen it all. Sister Xuerou is very brave. Don't be afraid, I'm here."
Feeling the trembling delicate body in his arms, Lin Ye touched her long hair again, and his voice became gentler.
"I came too late and frightened you."
Under his comfort, Zhang Xuerou finally stopped shaking.
After a while, she pushed Lin Ye away and wiped her tears in a panic.
Lin Ye touched her head:
"Sister Xuerou, this kind of thing will never happen again. Do you believe me?"
Zhang Xuerou didn't dare to look up at him, but nodded slightly, her voice as quiet as a mosquito's cry.
"I believe it."
Lin Ye smiled and took Zhang Xuerou's hand.
"Let's go home together."
Zhang Xuerou stopped struggling and let him hold her, as if this would give her peace of mind.
Lin Ye took a few steps and suddenly remembered something. He looked at Zhang Xuerou and opened the panel at the same time.
【Zhang Xuerou】
Charisma 83 (up to 92)
Favorability: 80.
He couldn't help but be startled.
Damn it, the favorability level is now 80?
Although the hero saves the beauty is cliché, the lethality is still amazing.
For an ancient woman, this good impression meant that she could marry him willingly.
The thought of getting married to Zhang Xuerou soon.
Lin Ye's bad mood improved a little.
All the way back to the village, it was already dark.
Zhang Xuerou tried to retract her hand, but Lin Ye refused to let her go.
She called softly: "Erlang."
